theme: An open day, with Croatia four days out.
greeting: A wide-open Friday, Dan — nothing on the calendar to steer around. The real pressure is the Croatia trip: a handful of P1 bookings that have to be locked from dry land before you fly on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Croatia bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: Your issued ticket shows 0 checked bags on Eurowings Discover. Verify the allowance on the operating carrier's own site and pre-buy if it isn't there — airport fees run far higher. Close it before Sept 8.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 19 Cavtat night + transfer
needsAttention.detail: The last night after the charter. Book a refundable Cavtat room and the noon Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer now, while you still have connectivity ashore.

needsAttention.title: Cover the Sept 20-22 St Pete gap
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sun the 20th; the girls aren't picked up until Tue the 22nd. Book two St Pete nights — and confirm the Sept 27-Oct 5 Airbnb flipped from pending to confirmed.

needsAttention.title: Sept 20 car — refundable backup
needsAttention.detail: Hold a refundable Full-Size SUV (TPA, Sept 20-Oct 5) unless Mike's car is confirmed en route. The decision point is Sept 7 — the day before you fly.
